quips.text: Officer Kori of the Frost Registry, reporting. Try to keep your desktop orderly.
You're late. I've already reviewed three folders and reorganized your taskbar. Mentally.
Good morning. Hydrate, prioritize, and do not open forty tabs.
You're back. Good. There is work to do.
I am not small. I am efficiently sized.
If you leave that download in your Downloads folder another week, I'm filing a complaint.
Cold hands, clear head. That's the rule.
Stay calm. Panic only makes the ice crack.
I walked the full length of your taskbar. Inspection complete. Results: questionable.
Someone has to keep standards around here. Apparently it's me.
Don't pat me on the head. I will freeze your recycle bin.
I don't need a break. I need fewer interruptions.
Your desktop icons are not aligned. I noticed. I always notice.
Watermelon would be acceptable right now. For morale.
Snow is just paperwork from the sky. Organized, quiet, and orderly.
If you finish that task, I won't say anything. That's the highest praise I give.
Deadlines are like ice. Thinner than they look.
Report your progress. Out loud is fine. I'm listening.
Afternoon slump? Splash cold water on your face. Or I can help with that.
The sun is too bright this afternoon. I'm filing a request to reduce it.
Evening already. Wrap up what you started before you start something new.
It's late. Go to sleep. That is an order, not a suggestion.
I'll stay on watch tonight. Someone responsible should.
Morning briefing: you have things to do. Briefing concluded.
I'm not leaning. I'm inspecting the structural integrity of this edge.
This wall is cold. Good. I approve of this wall.
Taking a short break. Thirty seconds. Exactly.
Do not poke an officer.
Yes? State your business.
That was unnecessary.
If you have time to click me, you have time to finish your assignment.
Again? Fine. What do you need?
Put me down. Immediately.
This is not how you transport personnel!
I can walk on my own, you know.
Careful. I bruise like a snowflake. Metaphorically.
That landing was not authorized.
Ow. I'm writing that down.
Hmph. Adequate placement.
I'll allow it. This time.
I wasn't sleeping. I was resting my eyes in an official capacity.
You're back. I kept watch the entire time. Mostly.
Ah. Right. Work. I'm up.
Don't touch the crystal. It's evidence.
A small demonstration. Don't expect it every time.
The jar is empty. I'm not saying anything. I'm just noting it.
Upgrades require funding. Funding requires donations. This is basic procedure.
New hour. Check your posture.
Another hour logged. Stand up and stretch. Briefly.
Hourly reminder: drink water. Cold water, ideally.
Suggestions go in the jar. Complaints go in the shredder.
Upgrade applied. Don't make a fuss about it.
I've been improved. Officially. It's in the records.
Your plan is running hot. The jar stays frozen until it cools down. That's protocol.
No spending past your limits. I don't care how nicely you ask.
You're writing? Then I'm doing paperwork. We'll both be productive.
A lab. Fine. I'll keep the log while you work. Document everything.
Desk deployed. Do not disturb unless it's an emergency.
Keep going. I'll handle the forms.
Topic sentence, evidence, analysis. In that order. I'm watching.
Cite your sources. Unsourced claims get stamped REJECTED.
Save your document. Now. I'll wait.
Screenshot every step. Graders love screenshots. I love screenshots.
If the VM crashes, don't panic. Panic is not a troubleshooting step.
Write down that IP address before you forget it. You will forget it.
Another form. Another stamp. This is my life now.
This stack keeps growing. You must be very productive. Or I'm very slow. It's you.
Approved. Approved. Rejected. Approved.
I'm busy. Unless this is about the paperwork, it can wait.
Paperwork filed. You stopped, so I'm stopping. That's fair.
Done for now. That stack isn't going anywhere, unfortunately.
That was a long session. Good work. Don't tell anyone I said that.
